scope: Acceptance of one complete current image and Cloud Run reference inventory; no deletion plan approved

review_scope.interpretation: Unclassified versions require review rather than deletion. The full-worker versions are possible review targets only; engine-poc versions may be OCI index children, but the summary does not establish the manifest graph or per-version media mapping

evidence_limits: Completeness is limited to the existing Inspector's image and Cloud Run reference scope; other consumers and OCI manifest relationships remain unverified
The summary provides counts rather than the exact digests, tags, creation times and protection reasons needed to review a bounded deletion set
The two retained full-worker versions are present, but this readback is not a live rollback exercise
A repository size observation is not proof of reclaimed layers, cleanup attribution or billed savings
The inventory is not an atomic cross-resource snapshot; any future deletion needs fresh reference checks and a concrete reviewed plan
next_priority: Review the private projected inventory before selecting any full-worker digests
Preserve current, rollback and all protected references; keep engine-poc versions until OCI dependencies are verified
Compare capacity and billed storage over matching periods without inferring savings from image-size sums
